close.title: Close diagnosis
close.sub: Confirm or correct the cause of a risk that has been acted on

system.noLongerActive: This risk no longer shows as active right now — most likely because the intervention already cleared it.
system.crossing: Cross-checking data, manual and previous cases…
system.orphan: No candidate causes have been recorded for this risk yet. You can still close the case by describing the cause below, in your own words.

conflict.title: The sources disagree
conflict.message: The manual and the previous cases back different causes. Review the evidence for each before choosing — the system has not resolved the disagreement for you.

person.title: Cause found
person.whatWasDonePlaceholder: The discharge valve was freed; it had seized.
person.didNotWorkNote: That is fine: it is recorded all the same, so nobody repeats the same attempt without knowing it has been tried.

missingRisk.title: No risk given
missingRisk.message: This screen opens from a risk card, in Risks.
missingRisk.error: No risk to diagnose was given.

done.title: Case recorded
done.message: It is in the logbook. Next time this symptom comes back, it will show up.

shift.title: Shift
shift.subtitle: What has happened since it started: actions, alarms and closed cases.
shift.quiet: No actions, alarms or cases in this window.

noShifts.title: Shifts are not configured
noShifts.body: A fixed window is being shown, not a real shift. For this screen to follow the plant schedule, declare {{variable}} on the server (for example: manana=6-14,tarde=14-22,noche=22-6).

simulated.title: Simulated source
simulated.body: Actions and cases come from the server; alarms come from the simulator. What you see here is not the plant real shift.

actions.title: Actions
actions.empty: Nobody operated anything in this window.
actions.pruned: Earlier entries are missing: the diary was pruned by size.

alarms.title: Alarm events
alarms.empty: No alarm was raised in this window.
alarms.partial: {{n}} alarm(s) could not be read; the list below is incomplete.

cases.title: Closed cases
cases.empty: No case was closed in this window.

timeline.notApplicable: no alarms are declared for this machine
timeline.incomplete: incomplete: one source could not be read
timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.perMachine: One per machine: the tank and the vibration system are separate installations and are never crossed.

findings.title: Findings
findings.subtitle: Active risks from both machines and similar cases backing their causes, in one place.
findings.empty: No pending findings: no active risk, or you have already seen them all.

notebook.title: Plant notebook
notebook.subtitle: Notes from whoever is in front of the machine — what a person says, not something the system did.
notebook.placeholder: Changed the filter, the pump makes noise on startup…
notebook.saveError: The note could not be saved
notebook.loadError: The notes could not be read
